how_to_confirm: Try the tissue test to check where your skin gets oily.
summary: Your forehead and nose look a bit oily, with a few small bumps on your forehead and chin. Your cheeks look calm and comfortable.

forehead.note: A bit oily, with a few small bumps.

nose.note: Some shine and a few visible pores.

left_cheek.note: A little redness near the nose.

chin.note: One or two small bumps and a faint mark.

red_flags.note: A few deeper, swollen-looking bumps on your chin.

products.why: A gentle wash keeps your skin clean without irritating it while you check in with a dermatologist.
